result.summary: The page is largely structured correctly, but the promotional banner has poor text legibility and the bottom navigation overlays the feed content. Some horizontal carousel items are visibly cut off at the right edge, which may be intentional but feels abrupt.

issues.description: The white heading and subtitle in the pale green promotional banner have very low contrast against the background, making the offer difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color, darken the banner background, or add a stronger overlay behind the text to meet contrast requirements.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the next restaurant card; the pizza image continues underneath the navigation and is visibly obscured.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable feed so cards stop above the fixed navigation bar.

issues.description: The restaurant carousel and category row cut off items sharply at the right edge, including the Trattoria card and the next category chip.
issues.suggestion: Add a deliberate edge fade/peek treatment or adjust spacing so the horizontal-scroll affordance looks intentional and less visually clipped.
